description: Source code for WebChatSwiftUI.swift, which implements a MacOS-specific SwiftUI frontend for OpenClaw chat, including window management, chat transport, and view model integration.

classes.name: WebChatSwiftUIWindowController
classes.description: Manages the display and interaction of the chat window for macOS, including showing, closing, positioning, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Requests chat history for a session asynchronously.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Sends a request to abort a chat run session.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of chat sessions asynchronously.

methods.name: setSessionModel
methods.description: Sets the model for a specific chat session.

methods.name: setSessionThinking
methods.description: Updates the thinking level for a chat session.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message in a chat session, potentially with attachments, asynchronously.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Checks the health of the connection to the server.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of chat transport events.
